name: Tanfac Industries Limited
summary: Tanfac Industries Limited manufactures and sells fluorine chemicals in India. The company provides anhydrous hydrofluoric acid, dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF), solar-grade DHF, potassium fluoride, potassium bifluoride, boron trifluoride complexes, aluminium fluoride, sulphuric acid and oleum, sodium silicofluoride, hydrogen fluoride pyridine complexes, hexafluorophosphoric acid, and refrigerant gas. It also exports its products. Tanfac Industries Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Cuddalore, India.
